mapper.sql: m.menu_id, m.site_id, m.parent_menu_id, m.menu_name, m.menu_type, m.link_target_id, m.link_url, m.sort_order, m.depth, m.auth_required_yn, m.use_yn, m.delete_yn, m.created_by, m.created_ip, m.created_at, m.updated_by, m.updated_ip, m.updated_at, s.site_code AS site_code, (SELECT IFNULL(MAX(layout_path), 'front/layouts/EMPTY/empty') FROM tb_template WHERE template_id = s.template_id) AS layout_path , p.menu_name AS parent_menu_name
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM tb_menu m LEFT JOIN tb_site s ON s.site_id = m.site_id LEFT JOIN tb_menu p ON p.menu_id = m.parent_menu_id
ORDER BY m.depth ASC, m.sort_order ASC, m.menu_name ASC

SELECT m.menu_id, m.site_id, m.parent_menu_id, m.menu_name, m.menu_type, m.link_target_id, m.link_url, m.sort_order, m.depth, m.auth_required_yn, m.use_yn, m.delete_yn, c.slug AS link_slug FROM tb_menu m LEFT JOIN tb_content c ON c.content_id = m.link_target_id AND c.delete_yn = 'N' WHERE m.site_id = #{siteId} AND m.delete_yn = 'N' AND m.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY m.depth ASC, m.sort_order ASC, m.menu_name ASC

SELECT FROM tb_menu m LEFT JOIN tb_site s ON s.site_id = m.site_id LEFT JOIN tb_menu p ON p.menu_id = m.parent_menu_id
AND (m.menu_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') OR m.link_url LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY m.menu_name ASC
SELECT FROM tb_menu m LEFT JOIN tb_site s ON s.site_id = m.site_id LEFT JOIN tb_menu p ON p.menu_id = m.parent_menu_id WHERE m.menu_id = #{menuId} AND m.delete_yn = 'N'

SELECT FROM tb_content c LEFT OUTER JOIN tb_site s ON c.site_id = s.site_id LEFT OUTER JOIN tb_menu m ON c.site_id = m.site_id AND c.menu_id = m.menu_id LEFT OUTER JOIN tb_menu p ON p.menu_id = m.parent_menu_id WHERE s.site_code = #{siteCode} AND c.slug = #{slug} AND c.delete_yn = 'N' AND m.delete_yn = 'N'

SELECT m.menu_id, m.site_id, m.parent_menu_id, m.menu_name, m.menu_type, m.link_target_id, m.link_url, m.sort_order, m.depth, m.auth_required_yn, m.use_yn, m.delete_yn, m.created_by, m.created_ip, m.created_at, m.updated_by, m.updated_ip, m.updated_at, (SELECT IFNULL(MAX(layout_path), 'front/layouts/EMPTY/empty') FROM tb_template WHERE template_id = s.template_id) AS layout_path ,
s.site_code AS site_code, s.site_name AS site_name
FROM tb_site s LEFT OUTER JOIN tb_menu m ON s.site_id = m.site_id WHERE s.site_code = #{siteCode} AND m.link_url = #{linkUrl} AND s.delete_yn = 'N' AND m.delete_yn = 'N' LIMIT 0,1

SELECT FROM tb_menu m LEFT JOIN tb_site s ON s.site_id = m.site_id LEFT JOIN tb_menu p ON p.menu_id = m.parent_menu_id WHERE m.site_id = #{siteId} AND m.delete_yn = 'N' AND
m.parent_menu_id = #{parentMenuId}
m.parent_menu_id IS NULL
ORDER BY m.sort_order ASC, m.menu_name ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tb_menu WHERE parent_menu_id = #{menuId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tb_content WHERE menu_id = #{menuId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_menu ( menu_id, site_id, parent_menu_id, menu_name, menu_type, link_target_id, link_url, sort_order, depth, auth_required_yn, use_yn, delete_yn, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{menuId}, #{siteId}, #{parentMenuId}, #{menuName}, #{menuType}, #{linkTargetId}, #{linkUrl}, #{sortOrder}, #{depth}, COALESCE(#{authRequiredYn}, 'N'), COALESCE(#{useYn}, 'Y'), 'N', #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp}, COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_menu SET menu_name=#{menuName}, menu_type=#{menuType}, link_target_id=#{linkTargetId}, link_url=#{linkUrl}, auth_required_yn=COALESCE(#{authRequiredYn}, auth_required_yn), use_yn=COALESCE(#{useYn}, use_yn), updated_by=#{updatedBy}, updated_ip=#{updatedIp}, updated_at=COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE menu_id = #{menuId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
UPDATE tb_menu SET sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE menu_id = #{menuId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
UPDATE tb_menu SET delete_yn = 'Y', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE menu_id = #{menuId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT m.menu_id, m.site_id, m.parent_menu_id, m.menu_name, m.menu_type, m.link_target_id, m.link_url, m.sort_order, m.depth, m.auth_required_yn, m.use_yn, m.delete_yn, m.created_by, m.created_ip, m.created_at, m.updated_by, m.updated_ip, m.updated_at, s.site_code AS site_code, c.slug AS link_slug, c.body, c.original_content, c.summary FROM tb_menu m LEFT JOIN tb_site s ON s.site_id = m.site_id LEFT JOIN tb_content c ON c.content_id = m.link_target_id AND c.delete_yn = 'N' WHERE m.delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY m.created_at ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_menu WHERE delete_yn = 'Y' AND updated_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
